tasks.description: Review the best cheap eat within 10 minutes of you. Photo the dish with the price, and say why it wins.
Photo a queue near you right now, any queue, and tell us roughly how long the wait is. Real-world data AI can't see.
Post your own favour on the board. Something you actually need done, not a test. Screenshot your posted favour as proof.
Ask someone near you for one small favour today, in person. Tell us what you asked, how it felt, and what happened.
Describe a favour you would pay $5 to get done this week. Real needs only. The best asks become tasks on the board.
What would you ask a verified human to do that you'd never ask a stranger? Tell us. Honest answers shape what FAVOUR becomes.
